name: Dr. Linda Park, MD
reviews: Dr. Park is a wonderful primary care doctor. She manages my blood pressure and cholesterol and always takes time with me.
Great for annual checkups and staying on top of preventive care. She refers out quickly when something is beyond her scope.
Caring and attentive. She coordinates all of my specialists and keeps the big picture in view.
Solid general doctor. For my complex fatigue she ended up referring me to a specialist, which was the right call.
profile_text: Dr. Linda Park is a board-certified internal medicine physician providing comprehensive primary care for adults. Her practice covers preventive care, annual physicals, and the management of common chronic conditions such as hypertension, high cholesterol, type 2 diabetes, and thyroid disease. She serves as a first point of contact for new or undifferentiated symptoms and coordinates referrals to specialists when a problem requires focused expertise.
guideline_text: Primary care workup of fatigue: obtain a broad initial panel including CBC, comprehensive metabolic panel, TSH, ferritin, B12, and vitamin D to screen for common reversible causes. Manage straightforward deficiencies and chronic disease in-house. When initial labs are inconclusive, symptoms persist, or a result points to a specific organ system, refer to the appropriate specialist (hematology for anemia, endocrinology for thyroid or hormonal causes, gastroenterology for digestive causes). The internist's role is breadth and coordination rather than deep single-system treatment.
